DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

I need to urgently check for visual loss, jaw claudication, scalp tenderness, and temporal artery abnormalities. Please describe the quality of your vision loss (e.g., curtain, dimming) and whether you experience pain when chewing or tenderness when touching your temples.
